clock: existing benchNow wrapper over native performance.now; monotonic
before_timer: source loading and static function compilation
timed: first target invocation and remaining N-1 calls
timing_not: pure interpreter-loop self time; no operation-level self time or frontend-percentage claim

calibration.selection: first power of two with pilot pair >=1500ms and all 6 independent confirmations >=1200ms

state: first call included; subsequent feedback/state evolve; not all-cold
